text_block_list.text:
I happened to run into Rice Shower in 
front of the school gates just as she was 
about to leave.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
—Well, you see. I'm going to buy a picture 
book now.

I found myself wondering a bit about what 
kind of picture books Rice Shower usually 
reads.
choice_data_list: If it's okay, can I come along?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You'll come with me? I'd love to go with 
you, Big Brother...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You'll come with me? I'd love to go with 
you, Big Sister...!

Having received permission, I decided to 
accompany them.

I came to buy the picture book I was 
looking for, but it was already sold 
out...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, I'm sorry, Big Brother... Even 
though you came all the way out here with 
me..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, I'm sorry, Big Sister... Even though 
you came all the way out here with me..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I really wanted to read that 
book...
choice_data_list:
You really do love picture books, don't 
you, Rice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. When I read picture books, it 
makes me feel so calm and at peace..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, picture books show us so many 
different worlds... They teach us so many 
wonderful things..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's why discovering a new picture book 
is always so exciting...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"I was really excited... for today, too, 
but..."
choice_data_list:
Shall we walk around and check some other 
shops?

I wonder if we can make a reservation or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: —Eh?

text_block_list.text: B-But, I'd feel bad for Onii-sama...

text_block_list.text: Big Brother—

text_block_list.text:
...Well then, just a little longer, 
together with――

That day, Rice Shower and I wandered 
around the nearby bookstores until dusk—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Big Brother, this...! This is the 
picture book...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Big Sister, this...! This is the 
picture book...!

At the last bookstore we visited, we found 
a single copy and rejoiced together.

Afterward, we read the picture book we 
bought together, and I got to see her 
radiant, happy face up close.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? A-A reservation? I wonder...

Even though it'll take a few days, they 
were able to reserve one for me from the 
next shipment...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Big Brother...! I didn't even 
think of making a reservation—
choice_data_list:
Because I wanted to read it together with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Big Sister! I didn't even think 
of making a reservation—
choice_data_list:
Because I wanted to read it together with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, once the picture book 
arrives... let's read it together, dear 
brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, once the picture book 
arrives... let's read it together, dear 
sister.

Seeing Rice Shower's expression brighten 
up made me happy as well.
